routes: /settings/roles (real RolesPanel, reader state, RBACAPI, API client and CSS with safe HTTP fixture)
states: Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock; Chromium 141.0.7390.37 and WebKit 26.0. Eight cases per source: desktop/light, phone/light, phone/dark, 320px/dark long-name and eleven-permission list. All sixteen comparable before/final captures copied to current output and opened through native view_image.

Built-in wildcard, four custom saved permissions and accepted empty role permissions: parent hides grants and clips row actions on phones. Final shows every exact grant under its role on phones, including read-only built-ins, and explicitly labels an empty role. Desktop retains identity, descriptions, full Permissions column and row controls.

Long saved strings outside editor shortcuts wrap without hiding or summarising content. No final page/table horizontal overflow. CSS chooses one visible permission representation at each width. No hover, expansion or editor required to inspect grants.
interactions: Real RBACAPI GET with existing expected-organization header and explicit synthetic served inventory. Exactly one roles read per case, no writes.

Keyboard Enter opens the custom role editor; every saved permission value remains exact. Editor Cancel, Delete/Cancel and New Role/Cancel retain the existing controls and dispatch no mutation. Built-in roles remain read-only.
No page errors or console errors in final paired browser runs. Proof is consuming-panel rendering, not full App shell, production-bundle pixels, installed account or original estate recovery.
